description: Verify platform file bytes and create one immutable File Package, Requirement Version, Customer Confirmation binding and QDP Draft in the Customer Request transaction.
agent_hint: Prepare a QDP Draft only from the exact Customer Request target. The server computes File Package Hash from platform bytes and binds it to a new Requirement Version and customer confirmation evidence. expectedVersion and clientRequestId must come from the command envelope.

description: Validate GT-D04 completeness and advance a Draft QDP revision to Ready for Review under optimistic concurrency.
agent_hint: Submit only a Draft or Validation Failed QDP revision. Exact target pid, Customer Request pid and expectedVersion are mandatory; confirmation/hash, Pack Set and downstream responsibility are re-read server-side.

description: Release an exact Ready for Review QDP revision, revalidate confirmation/hash/qualification/file retention, supersede the previous release and link only the new revision pid to the PCBA sidecar.
agent_hint: Release only a Ready for Review QDP revision. The command revalidates the exact Requirement Version + File Package Hash customer confirmation, current Customer Request version, PCBA qualification and retained file set. Content is never patched after preparation.

description: Freeze an immutable QDP revision under the targeted Customer Request after optimistic-version, qualification, file-ownership and permission guards pass.
agent_hint: Release one append-only QDP revision for the targeted Customer Request with public platform file pid references. Optimistic concurrency and idempotency come only from the server-owned expectedVersion and clientRequestId command contexts; payload version fields are ignored.
